result: No actionable correctness finding in reviewed scope
method: Static source review against recovered heap, PTD, PTD-data, error, invalid-parameter and thread interfaces; existing test result inspected, not rerun by reviewer
observations: construct_at with no arguments establishes live value-initialized Ptd and Context in suitably aligned provider-owned storage; zero/null field semantics match the Windows x64 record domain
Ptd and Context are trivially destructible; successful storage release ends their lifetime without a required destructor call, while HeapFree failure retains storage and object lifetime
HeapErrors preserves the recovered mapping/address contracts and composes the actual errno cell selection rather than writing a substitute TLS cell

Recursive allocation-failure errno lookup reaches the recovered FLS construction sentinel, returns fallback storage and terminates recursion; errno_fallback=12 and dos_fallback=8 match their initial state
FLS API fields use SDK declaration-derived function pointer types; allocation maps the one supported recovered destructor token to a caller-supplied rebuilt callback
The actual application entry call uses the recovered unsigned __stdcall(void*) domain; supplied entry addresses must denote correctly typed rebuilt functions
Production native_fls_api only takes six SDK API addresses; synthetic fixtures invoke supplied replacements rather than real FLS operations
required_contracts: Heap provider supplies sufficient storage with alignment for Ptd and Context
All borrowed states, Identities, providers and rebuilt callbacks outlive adapter use and every FLS/worker callback
The callback's caller-owned binding dispatches to the same PTD/data/heap ownership domain
Raw original binary addresses and incorrectly typed function addresses are outside the entry invocation contract
Real native heap/FLS/CRT loader lifecycle, concurrent shutdown and original runtime equivalence remain unverified
minor_hygiene_note: glue_tests.cpp uses std::find/count through transitive includes; reviewer suggested a direct algorithm header include to the parent worker

primary_followup.change: Added explicit <algorithm> include to glue_tests.cpp as suggested; no production semantic change
